# Thrivefold

> Thrivefold is a private health and wellbeing app for iOS and Android, currently in beta.
> Website: https://thrivefold.devamit.co.in
> Made by Amit Dev Labs (https://devamit.co.in)

## What it does
- Daily check-ins for mood, sleep and energy, with small daily quests.
- Dedicated spaces for women's health (including cycle tracking), men's health and LGBTQ+ wellbeing.
- Guided workouts with an on-device camera coach. Camera video is not uploaded.
- Meal logging.
- Circles: private groups for training, meditation, sports and support that open up as you build a routine.

## Privacy
- Health records are encrypted on the user's phone.
- Records can be exported as HL7 FHIR and deleted from the settings screen.
- No ads.

## Not medical care
Thrivefold is a wellbeing and fitness tool. It does not diagnose or treat conditions and is not an emergency service.
